event Claimed(address indexed user, uint256 amount)
event ContestCreated(uint256 indexed contestId, uint256 indexed matchId, uint256 entryFee, uint256 sponsoredPool, uint32 maxEntries, uint16[] prizeBps)
event ContestJoined(uint256 indexed contestId, uint256 indexed entryIndex, address indexed user, uint256 teamId)
event ContestSettled(uint256 indexed contestId, uint256 prizePool, uint256 platformFee)
event EntryRanked(uint256 indexed contestId, uint256 indexed entryIndex, address indexed user, uint256 rank, int256 score, uint256 prize)
event MatchCreated(uint256 indexed matchId, uint8 sport, string name, uint64 startTime, bytes32 rulesHash, string metadataURI)
event ResultsPosted(uint256 indexed matchId, bytes32 statsHash, string statsRef, int32[] points)
event RoleAdminChanged(bytes32 indexed role, bytes32 indexed previousAdminRole, bytes32 indexed newAdminRole)
event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender)
event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender)
event TeamSaved(uint256 indexed teamId, uint256 indexed matchId, address indexed owner, uint8[11] picks, uint8 captain, uint8 viceCaptain)

function createContest((uint256 matchId, uint256 entryFee, uint256 sponsoredPool, uint32 maxEntries, uint32 minEntries, uint8 maxEntriesPerUser, uint16 platformFeeBps, uint16[] prizeBps) p) payable returns (uint256 contestId)
function createMatch(uint8 sport, string name, uint64 startTime, (uint8 side, uint8 role, uint8 credits)[] players, bytes32 rulesHash, string metadataURI) returns (uint256 matchId)
function createTeam(uint256 matchId, uint8[11] picks, uint8 captain, uint8 viceCaptain) returns (uint256 teamId)
function editTeam(uint256 teamId, uint8[11] picks, uint8 captain, uint8 viceCaptain)

function getContest(uint256 contestId) view returns ((uint256 matchId, uint256 entryFee, uint256 sponsoredPool, address sponsor, uint32 maxEntries, uint32 minEntries, uint8 maxEntriesPerUser, uint16 platformFeeBps, uint8 status, uint16[] prizeBps))
function getEntries(uint256 contestId) view returns ((address user, uint256 teamId)[])

function getMatch(uint256 matchId) view returns ((uint8 sport, uint8 status, uint64 startTime, uint64 resultsPostedAt, uint32 settledContests, bytes32 rulesHash, bytes32 statsHash, string name, string metadataURI, string statsRef))
function getPlayers(uint256 matchId) view returns ((uint8 side, uint8 role, uint8 credits)[])
function getTeam(uint256 teamId) view returns ((address owner, uint256 matchId, uint8[11] picks, uint8 captain, uint8 viceCaptain))
function getTeamsOf(uint256 matchId, address user) view returns (uint256[])
function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) view returns (bool)
function joinContest(uint256 contestId, uint256 teamId) payable
function postResults(uint256 matchId, int32[] points, bytes32 statsHash, string statsRef)
function scoreOfTeam(uint256 teamId) view returns (int256 score)
